title: Gum flap surgery
what: The doctor carefully lifts the gum and cleans the tooth roots of tartar and inflammation. Then the gum is put back and stitched.
why: For gum disease with deep pockets, when regular cleaning does not help.
tell_doctor: All medicines, especially blood thinners, as the doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies, especially to painkillers and antibiotics

prepare.title: Cleaning
prepare.text: A professional teeth cleaning is usually done before the surgery.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat 1 to 2 hours before the surgery.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: No alcohol. It is better to stop smoking beforehand, so ask your doctor.

steps: The doctor makes small cuts and lifts the gum
Removes tartar and inflamed tissue from the roots
Sometimes places material to rebuild the bone
The gum is put back and stitched
feel: The injection is unpleasant, then pressure and the sounds of instruments
Afterward, pain and swelling for a few days, and you are given a painkiller
Your teeth may be sensitive to cold
after: Hold a cold pack on your cheek for the first hours, with breaks
Soft, not hot, food for a few days
Do not brush the surgery area until your doctor allows
Rinse your mouth as your doctor prescribed
Stitches are usually removed after 1 to 2 weeks
red_flags: Bleeding does not stop when you press with gauze
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or swelling that grows after day 3
Swelling spreads to the neck, or trouble swallowing or breathing: call emergency services

faq.q: Why did my gum recede after surgery?
faq.a: This happens when the inflammation goes away. Your doctor will say what can be done.
Better not to: smoking slows gum healing.

reminders.text: Gum surgery tomorrow. No alcohol. Eat 1 to 2 hours before the visit. Take your medicines as your doctor said.
